title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in KR Puram

content.rendered:
Looking for a container office in KR Puram you can buy direct from the people who build it? SAMAN Portable manufactures steel container offices at our Bengaluru factory in Gopasandra (560099) and supplies them across KR Puram and the wider Whitefield–Hoskote corridor. You get a factory-built unit, real specifications, and one point of contact from quote to installation.

Whether you need a compact site cabin for a project office or a 40ft unit for a permanent team, we build to order on an MS steel frame and deliver ready to use.

Container Offices for Sale in KR Puram

SAMAN Portable sells new, made-to-order container offices for businesses in KR Puram and east Bengaluru. Each unit is built on an MS steel frame to IS 2062, finished for daily office use, and delivered fully assembled to your site. Choose 10ft, 20ft, or 40ft, and we customise the layout, doors, windows, and electrical points to suit your work.

Container office sizes we supply

We manufacture three standard footprints. Each is built to order, so internal partitions, window count, and finishes are adjusted to your requirement.

SizeTypical useSuits
10ftSingle-desk site office, security or supervisor cabin1–2 people
20ftProject office, sales or admin room, meeting space3–5 people
40ftLarger team office, multi-cabin or partitioned layout6–10 people

Units can be combined or stacked where the site allows, so the office can grow as your team grows.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

Because we are the manufacturer, there is no middleman between you and the build. Every container office is fabricated on an MS steel frame to IS 2062 at our Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 factory, by a company holding ISO 9001:2015 certification.

  • Build quality: MS steel frame and base built to IS 2062, finished for working office conditions.
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.
  • Delivery: standard delivery from ₹3,000, with typical transit of 3–5 days within and around Bengaluru.
  • Returns: within 7 days of delivery or installation.
  • One point of contact: the same team handles your quote, build, dispatch, and installation.

Delivery and installation in KR Puram

KR Puram sits on the east side of Bengaluru along the Whitefield–Hoskote corridor, close to the industrial and commercial belts our units commonly serve. We deliver across Bengaluru and into KR Puram and surrounding areas on a flatbed, place the unit with crane support where access requires it, and hand it over ready to connect. Tell us your access — gate width, ground level, and crane room — and we plan the dispatch around it.

Get a container office quote in KR Puram

Tell us the size, layout, and where the unit is going in KR Puram, and we will send a current quote with specifications. To buy a container office or ask about a custom build, call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry. You can also explore our full container office range for sizes and configurations.

FAQs


What container office sizes can I buy in KR Puram?

We supply 10ft, 20ft, and 40ft container offices, all built to order. Units can be combined or stacked where the site allows, so you can scale the office to your team.


How long does delivery to KR Puram take?

Typical transit is about 3–5 days within and around Bengaluru once your order and layout are confirmed. Standard delivery starts from ₹3,000, and we plan dispatch around your site access.


Can I customise the layout of my container office?

Yes. Because every unit is built to order, we adjust the partitions, doors, windows, and electrical points to suit your work before fabrication.


What warranty comes with a SAMAN container office?

Every unit carries 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.


How are the container offices built?

Each office is fabricated on an MS steel frame to IS 2062 at our Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 factory by a company holding ISO 9001:2015 certification, then delivered fully assembled.


How do I order a container office in KR Puram?

Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry with your size, layout, and site location. We confirm specifications, send a current quote, and schedule delivery and installation.

author.description: Aman Dubey is the lead marketing and copywriting expert at Saman Portable, specializing in prefabricated, shipping-container, and modular structures. With over 15 years of industry experience, Aman has helped global clients optimize design, streamline production, and amplify brand visibility through data-driven content and strategic SEO. Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
